property-characteristics.notes: Checked real vs personal property, fixtures/MARIA, trade fixtures, emblements, physical (immobile, indestructible, unique) vs economic (scarcity, improvements, permanence, situs) traits, three legal description methods, township 6 mi sq / 36 sections / 640 acres, NE1/4 of SW1/4 = 40 acres, street address not a legal description. land-use-controls.notes: Checked PETE powers (police power uncompensated; eminent domain with just compensation via condemnation; escheat with no will and no heirs), nonconforming use, variance for hardship, CC&Rs/HOA, easement appurtenant vs in gross, license revocable, encroachment. All correct.

ownership-estates.notes: Checked fee simple absolute, life estate / pur autre vie, reversion vs remainder, four leaseholds incl. sufferance, joint tenancy four unities (PTTI) and survivorship, buyer from a joint tenant becomes tenant in common, condo vs co-op (shares + proprietary lease), tax/special assessment liens first, judgment general vs mortgage specific. All correct.

deeds-title-recording.notes: Checked deed elements (writing, competent grantor, identifiable grantee, legal description, words of conveyance, consideration, grantor signature), delivery and acceptance pass title, general/special warranty and quitclaim, constructive vs actual notice, chain of title/abstract, owner's vs lender's title policy, adverse possession elements (period set by state), devise vs bequest, quiet title, recording not needed for validity between parties. All correct.

value-appraisal.notes: Checked market value vs price, DUST, substitution, regression/progression, comparable-better-subtract, cost approach formula, three forms of depreciation (external usually incurable), V = I/R, debt service not an operating expense, GRM on monthly rent ($1,500 x 120 = $180,000 correct), CMA/BPO not an appraisal. All correct.

contracts.notes: Checked valid contract elements, Statute of Frauds, bilateral/unilateral, minor = voidable, illegal purpose = void, executed/executory, counteroffer rejects offer, equitable title, option (optionor bound, optionee not), remedies, liquidated damages. 'Largest part of the largest content area' is consistent with the 2025 Pearson VUE outline (Contracts and Agency 16 items, largest; contract topics A-D = 9 of 16). Minor wording note only: 'Contingencies ... must be met before the deal becomes binding' follows the common textbook definition; more precise is 'must be met or waived before the parties must close' (a contingent contract is already a valid contract). Not a FAIL. | 권고 문구(조건부 조항 'met or waived before closing') 반영 뒤 새 에이전트 재확인 PASS

agency.notes: Checked principal vs customer, listing creates seller-broker agency, express/implied creation, termination events (incl. death or incapacity of either party, destruction, revocation/renunciation), OLD CAR duties, confidentiality of motivation/lowest price, honesty and disclosure of known material defects to customers, dual agency only where state law permits with informed (written) consent. Correctly framed as state-dependent. Correct.

disclosures-environmental.notes: Checked material fact, puffing vs misrepresentation, lead rule (pre-1978 target housing, disclose known LBP/hazards and records, EPA-approved pamphlet 'Protect Your Family From Lead in Your Home', 10-day inspection opportunity unless waived or changed by mutual written agreement), radon (uranium decay, test only), asbestos (dangerous when disturbed, encapsulation), USTs, CERCLA 42 U.S.C. 9601 et seq. (strict, joint and several; current and past owners/operators, arrangers, transporters), Phase I ESA / all appropriate inquiries supports innocent landowner defense, flood insurance mandatory for federally backed/regulated loans in SFHAs (correctly hedged 'generally'). Source note (not an error): the disclosure rule is codified jointly at 40 CFR 745 Subpart F (EPA) and 24 CFR 35 Subpart A (HUD); suggest org string 'EPA/HUD lead disclosure rule (40 CFR 745 Subpart F; 24 CFR 35 Subpart A)'. | 납 페인트 인용을 '40 CFR 745 Subpart F; 24 CFR 35 Subpart A' 로 보강한 뒤 새 에이전트 재확인 PASS
